query: SELECT lf.name, ffs.transactionType, ffs.legalFee, ffs.fileOpeningFee FROM law_firms lf JOIN firm_fee_structures ffs ON lf.id = ffs.firmId WHERE lf.isActive = 1 AND ffs.transactionType IN ('sale','purchase') ORDER BY lf.name, ffs.transactionType, ffs.legalFee LIMIT 20;
